title: A noisy hotel room
instructions: Bir misafir gürültülü odası için resepsiyona şikâyette bulunuyor. Uzun bir diyalog; sorunları ve çözümleri eşleştir. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Good morning. I'm in room 214. I'm afraid I didn't sleep at all last night.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. What was the problem?

script.speaker: a
script.text: There was loud music from the bar until two in the morning. My room is right above it.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I'm very sorry. The bar should close at midnight. I'll speak to the manager.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Thank you. Also, the shower is very weak. The water just drips.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I see. Would you like to change rooms? We have a quiet room on the fifth floor, at the back of the hotel.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Does it have a better shower?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, all the rooms on that floor were renovated last year.

script.speaker: b
script.text: And because of the problems, we won't charge you for last night.

options: There was loud music from the bar.
People were talking in the corridor.
questions.feedback: Bardan sabah ikiye kadar yüksek müzik geldi.
questions.evidence: There was loud music from the bar until two in the morning.
The bar should close at midnight.

questions.prompt: What is wrong with the shower?

options: on the fifth floor at the front
on the fifth floor at the back
questions.feedback: Beşinci katta, otelin arka tarafında sessiz bir oda.
questions.evidence: We have a quiet room on the fifth floor, at the back of the hotel.

questions.prompt: What will the hotel do because of the problems?
options: not charge him for last night
give him a discount next time
questions.evidence: we won't charge you for last night.
